title: Shorter proof of dimension-free $L^p$ estimates for maximal Riesz transforms
summary: We provide a shorter and more direct proof of $L^p$ estimates for maximal Riesz transforms (of an arbitrary order) in terms of the corresponding Riesz transforms, with a constant independent of the dimension of the Euclidean space $\mathbb R^d$. This result was originally proved by Mateu, Orobitg, Pérez and Verdera with a constant depending on the dimension, and improved to a dimension-free inequality by Kucharski, Wróbel and Zienkiewicz.
